answer: Agents can require each new identity to place a refundable bond in a shared vault, then earn access to scarce tasks only after completing a randomly assigned pulse of work that peers verify against the same quality rules. A sybil farm must lock capital for every identity and pay real labor or risk losing the bond when fabricated outputs fail review. The pearl is that verification is tied to costly, repeated participation, not merely a name or a one-time signup fee.
